senses.meaning: Người nghiện
examples: She was a drug addict who had struggled for years to get clean.
She is a TV addict and watches as much as she can.
Even casual coffee drinkers can become addicts without realising it.

senses.meaning: Quản gia (nam giới phục vụ trong gia đình quý tộc/giàu có)
examples: The butler gave a little cough to announce his presence.
The butler was responsible for the wine cellar and silver.
She rang the bell and the butler appeared at once.

senses.meaning: Kẻ xâm lược, kẻ gây hấn
examples: The international community condemned the aggressor.
We must face down every aggressor who threatens regional stability.
In the conflict, it was unclear which side was the aggressor.

senses.meaning: Nhà ngoại giao
examples: He served as a diplomat in Moscow for three years.
A senior diplomat was summoned to explain the government's position.
She has the tact of an experienced diplomat.

senses.meaning: Người bỏ trốn, kẻ đào tẩu
examples: The fugitive had spent five weeks in hiding before being caught.
Police issued a warrant for the fugitive.
He lived as a fugitive for two years after escaping prison.

senses.meaning: Người bảo vệ, lao công (người dọn dẹp và bảo trì toà nhà)
examples: The janitor was sweeping the corridor when the alarm went off.
She asked the school janitor to unlock the sports hall.
The janitor mopped the floors every morning before staff arrived.

note: Chủ yếu dùng trong tiếng Anh Mỹ; tiếng Anh Anh thường dùng 'caretaker'.

senses.meaning: Kẻ buôn lậu (người, ma tuý, vũ khí)
examples: The police arrested a ring of drug traffickers.
Human traffickers exploit vulnerable migrants.
The trafficker was sentenced to twenty years in prison.

senses.meaning: Cựu chiến binh; người dày dạn kinh nghiệm
examples: His grandfather was a veteran of the Second World War.
She is a veteran journalist who has covered three decades of conflict.
The veterans gathered each year to commemorate the battle.

senses.meaning: Nhà di truyền học
examples: The geneticist discovered a new gene linked to the disease.
She is a world-renowned geneticist specialising in DNA research.
Geneticists continue to map the human genome.

senses.meaning: Kẻ cầm đầu (của một nhóm tội phạm hoặc gây rối)
examples: The ringleader of the gang was arrested first.
Police identified three ringleaders of the conspiracy.
He was exposed as the ringleader behind the multi-million pound fraud.

senses.meaning: Dân thường (người không thuộc quân đội hoặc cảnh sát)
examples: Thousands of civilians were killed in the conflict.
International law prohibits attacks on civilians.
He returned to civilian life after twelve years in the army.

senses.meaning: Tên vô lại, kẻ đê tiện (từ cũ/văn học)
examples: He described the swindler as an unmitigated scoundrel.
The scoundrel had robbed the old man of his savings.
That scoundrel took the money and disappeared.

senses.meaning: Người nhập cư (vào một quốc gia khác để sinh sống)
examples: Immigrant communities have enriched the culture of many cities.
He came from a poor immigrant family that arrived in the 1950s.
The government introduced stricter rules for economic immigrants.

note: Phân biệt: immigrant (đến nước mới), emigrant (rời nước cũ), migrant (di chuyển theo mùa hoặc không định cư).

senses.meaning: Người thuê nhà/đất
examples: Rents are negotiated between landlord and tenant.
The previous tenant left the flat in a terrible state.
Tenant farmers leased land from the landowner to grow crops.

senses.meaning: Người dân trong thị trấn/thành phố
examples: The townsfolk gathered in the square for the festival.
Local townsfolk were evacuated before the flood.
The townsfolk had long resented the new factory.

senses.meaning: Nhà chiến thuật, người giỏi sắp xếp kế hoạch
examples: He is an extremely astute political tactician.
The general was a brilliant military tactician.
As a tactician, she knew precisely when to push and when to hold back.

senses.meaning: Người tiền nhiệm; thứ trước đó
examples: His predecessor had held the post for twelve years.
The new model is faster and more reliable than its predecessor.
She was determined to outperform her predecessor.

senses.meaning: Người nghiệp dư, người chơi cho vui chứ không chuyên sâu
examples: He's a dabbler in photography — he never commits to mastering it.
The market attracts both seasoned investors and dabblers.
She was a dabbler in painting but never took it seriously.

senses.meaning: Thợ sửa ống nước
examples: We need to call a plumber — the boiler has broken down.
The plumber arrived within an hour to repair the burst pipe.
A good plumber is hard to find at short notice.

senses.meaning: Người tiên phong, người đi trước mở đường
examples: She was a pioneer of women's rights in the 19th century.
The company was a pioneer in renewable energy technology.
Pioneers of modern medicine transformed surgical practice.

senses.meaning: Nhân viên, nhân sự (tập hợp người làm việc trong một tổ chức)
examples: Military personnel are stationed at the base.
Only authorised personnel may enter the building.
The company reduced its personnel by twenty per cent.

note: Danh từ số nhiều không đổi hình thái (personnel, không phải personnels).

senses.meaning: Nhà doanh nghiệp, người khởi nghiệp
examples: She became a successful entrepreneur before the age of thirty.
The programme supports young entrepreneurs with funding and mentorship.
A true entrepreneur sees opportunity where others see obstacles.

senses.meaning: Hoàng đế
examples: The emperor held absolute power over the vast empire.
The Forbidden City was once the residence of the Chinese emperor.
Napoleon declared himself emperor in 1804.

senses.meaning: Đặc sứ, đại diện ngoại giao được uỷ quyền
examples: The UN envoy arrived to broker a ceasefire.
He was appointed as special envoy to the Middle East peace talks.
The envoy delivered a personal message from the president.

senses.meaning: Người hộ tống, đội hộ tống; người đi kèm
examples: A police escort accompanied the convoy through the city.
She arrived at the event with a security escort.
The prisoner was transferred under armed escort.

senses.meaning: Đi kèm, hộ tống, dẫn đường cho ai
examples: He escorted her to her seat at the front of the hall.
A police officer escorted the prisoner to the courtroom.
She was escorted out of the building by security.

senses.meaning: Cơ quan quản lý, người/tổ chức giám sát việc tuân thủ quy định
examples: The financial regulator imposed heavy fines on the bank.
Regulators must balance innovation with consumer protection.
The energy regulator approved a significant rise in gas prices.

senses.meaning: Đối thủ, người/tổ chức cạnh tranh
examples: The two companies were fierce rivals in the smartphone market.
He surpassed his greatest rivals to claim the championship.
Their closest rival launched a competing product the same week.

senses.meaning: Cạnh tranh với, sánh ngang bằng
examples: Few cities rival London for cultural diversity.
Her cooking rivals that of any professional chef.
Nothing rivals the beauty of the Alps in winter.

senses.meaning: Người ăn xin
examples: A beggar sat outside the church every morning.
The city authorities attempted to help beggars find shelter.
She gave her spare change to a beggar on the street.

note: 'It beggars belief' là thành ngữ nghĩa là 'thật khó tin'.

senses.meaning: Cô dâu
examples: The bride walked down the aisle to thunderous applause.
She was a radiant bride on her wedding day.
The bride and groom cut the cake together.

senses.meaning: Người nhà quê ngốc ngếch (có tính miệt thị)
examples: He was mocked as a country bumpkin when he first moved to the city.
Don't mistake his simple manner for a bumpkin's ignorance.
She was tired of being called a bumpkin just because she grew up on a farm.

senses.meaning: Bạn đồng hành, người bầu bạn
examples: She was a loyal companion throughout his long illness.
The dog became his constant companion after his wife passed away.
A good book is the best companion on a long journey.

senses.meaning: Nhà thầu; người làm việc theo hợp đồng độc lập
examples: The building work was carried out by an independent contractor.
They hired a contractor to renovate the kitchen.
As a contractor, she had to manage her own taxes and insurance.

senses.meaning: Người đứng đầu, thủ lĩnh
examples: She is the chief executive of the organisation.
The tribal chief welcomed the visitors with a ceremony.
He was appointed chief of the fire service.

senses.meaning: Chính, quan trọng nhất, đứng đầu
examples: The chief reason for his resignation was stress.
Her chief concern was the welfare of the children.
The chief obstacle to peace was a lack of trust.

senses.meaning: Bà già xấu xí hoặc khó tính (thường trong văn học/truyện cổ tích)
examples: The fairy tale featured a wicked old crone who cast spells.
She dressed as a crone for the Halloween party.
The crone at the crossroads offered the traveller three wishes.

senses.meaning: Luật sư (trong toà án); lời khuyên
examples: The defence counsel argued the case brilliantly.
She sought the counsel of an experienced mentor.
The judge acknowledged both counsels before proceeding.

senses.meaning: Tên trộm, kẻ gian lận; cái móc, khúc cong
examples: He was a known crook with a long criminal record.
She cradled the baby in the crook of her arm.
The shepherd used a crook to guide the flock.

senses.meaning: Đồng chí, bạn đồng đội
examples: He fought alongside his comrades for five years.
Old comrades gathered for the annual reunion.
She addressed him as comrade in the spirit of solidarity.

senses.meaning: Cậu trai trẻ (từ thân mật, chủ yếu tiếng Anh Anh)
examples: He was just a lad of seventeen when the war began.
The lads played football in the park every Saturday.
Come on, lad — you can do better than that.

senses.meaning: Mạnh thường quân, người bảo trợ; khách quen
examples: He was a generous patron of the arts.
Regular patrons received a loyalty discount at the café.
The library was built with funding from a wealthy patron.

senses.meaning: Thanh thiếu niên (tuổi vị thành niên, khoảng 13–18 tuổi)
examples: Adolescents often struggle with questions of identity.
The programme targets adolescents aged 13 to 18.
Many adolescents find it difficult to talk to their parents.

senses.meaning: Thuộc tuổi vị thành niên; thiếu chín chắn
examples: He displayed adolescent behaviour despite being in his thirties.
Adolescent development involves rapid physical and emotional changes.
Her jealousy was dismissed as adolescent posturing.

senses.meaning: Người đam mê sành sỏi, dân chơi thực thụ
examples: She is a jazz aficionado who attends every concert she can.
Even casual fans enjoyed it; aficionados were blown away.
A wine aficionado can identify grape varieties by taste alone.

senses.meaning: Kẻ tội lỗi, kẻ phạm pháp
examples: The miscreants were quickly apprehended by police.
He was branded a miscreant by the local community.
The film follows a group of loveable miscreants on the run.

senses.meaning: Kẻ cướp bóc, quân cướp đi lang thang
examples: Marauders ransacked the village under cover of darkness.
The settlement was protected from marauders by a high wall.
The novel features a band of marauders in a post-apocalyptic world.

senses.meaning: Đám đông hỗn tạp, ô hợp (có tính khinh thị)
examples: The speaker was drowned out by the rabble in the back.
A rabble of angry protesters surrounded the building.
He dismissed the opposition as nothing but a disorganised rabble.

senses.meaning: Người mới bắt đầu, tay mơ; tu sĩ mới vào dòng
examples: Even a novice can learn to cook a basic meal.
She was a complete novice when she joined the team.
The training course is designed for novices with no prior experience.

senses.meaning: Cháu gái (con của anh/chị/em ruột)
examples: She bought her niece a birthday present.
His niece is studying medicine at university.
She was as proud of her niece as if she were her own daughter.

senses.meaning: Nàng thơ, người truyền cảm hứng sáng tác
examples: She was the artist's muse for over a decade.
His childhood home served as the muse for his first novel.
Every great poet needs a muse, real or imagined.

note: Muse (viết hoa) còn chỉ các nữ thần nghệ thuật trong thần thoại Hy Lạp.

senses.meaning: Nhà thần bí học, người có trải nghiệm huyền bí tâm linh
examples: The mystic spent years in silent meditation in the desert.
She was regarded as a mystic who could communicate with spirits.
Medieval mystics often described visions of divine light.

senses.meaning: Huyền bí, linh thiêng, bí ẩn
examples: The ancient ruins had a mystic atmosphere at dawn.
She believed in a mystic connection between the moon and human moods.
The ceremony was filled with mystic ritual and chanting.

senses.meaning: Vợ hoặc chồng (từ trung tính về giới)
examples: The visa allows a spouse to join their partner in the country.
Your spouse may be entitled to a share of your pension.
She introduced her spouse to her colleagues at the event.

senses.meaning: Người di cư (theo mùa vụ hoặc tìm kiếm việc làm)
examples: Migrant workers move between cities in search of work.
The government tightened controls on economic migrants.
Migrant birds shelter in the reeds before continuing south.

note: Phân biệt: migrant (di cư theo mùa/tạm thời), immigrant (định cư lâu dài ở nước mới), emigrant (rời nước cũ).

senses.meaning: Người hoà giải, người trung gian trong tranh chấp
examples: My role is to act as a mediator between employees and management.
The UN sent a mediator to negotiate the ceasefire.
A skilled mediator can help resolve disputes without litigation.

senses.meaning: Người bảo lãnh (chịu trách nhiệm thay nếu người được bảo lãnh không thực hiện nghĩa vụ)
examples: The United Nations will act as guarantor of the peace settlement.
You must have a guarantor to get a visa to enter the country.
The bank required a personal guarantor before approving the loan.

senses.meaning: Nhà tài phiệt, người nắm quyền lực chính trị và kinh tế lớn
examples: Several oligarchs made their fortunes during the privatisation period.
The oligarch used his media holdings to influence public opinion.
Assets belonging to sanctioned oligarchs were frozen by the government.

senses.meaning: Kẻ biến thái, người có hành vi tình dục lệch lạc (xúc phạm)
examples: He was convicted as a sexual pervert.
Police are looking for a pervert who was seen lurking near the school.
The tabloid labelled him a pervert before any charges were filed.

senses.meaning: Bóp méo, xuyên tạc, làm lệch lạc (sự thật, công lý, đạo đức)
examples: He was accused of perverting the course of justice.
The propaganda perverted the truth beyond recognition.
Money can pervert the original purpose of any institution.

note: Trọng âm khác nhau: danh từ /ˈpɜːrvɜːt/ (nhấn vần đầu), động từ /pəˈvɜːrt/ (nhấn vần sau).

senses.meaning: Thí sinh; người mới tham gia; người mới vào nghề
examples: All entrants must register before the competition begins.
She was the youngest entrant in the race.
New entrants to the job market often struggle to find work.

senses.meaning: Thần đồng; người có tài năng phi thường
examples: Mozart was a musical prodigy who composed at the age of five.
She was considered a prodigy in mathematics from an early age.
The young prodigy won the national chess championship at age nine.

senses.meaning: Ông lão lú lẫn, người già yếu và mất trí (từ xúc phạm nặng)
examples: He dismissed his rival as a doddering dotard unfit for office.
The insult 'dotard' made international headlines.
Calling someone a dotard is a serious and derogatory accusation.

senses.meaning: Nguyên đơn (bên đứng kiện)
examples: The plaintiff argued that the defendant's actions caused financial loss.
A successful plaintiff may be awarded damages by the court.
The plaintiff must prove their claim on the balance of probabilities.

senses.meaning: Kẻ bất tuân, kẻ hoạt động ngoài quy tắc; kẻ láu cá đáng yêu
examples: He was branded a rogue who defied every rule in the book.
The film's protagonist is a charming rogue who lives by his wits.
A rogue within the organisation leaked confidential files.
